title: Implement sign-up/login using Internet Identity (not custom username/password) and finalize CloudCam AI login-gated account creation flow

requirements.text: Do not implement a custom backend username/password authentication system; keep Internet Identity as the only sign-up/login method and ensure the UI copy consistently describes Internet Identity as the authentication mechanism.

quotes: Add a user account system to CloudCam AI so users can sign up and log in.

acceptanceCriteria: There is no username/password registration or login API added to the backend canister.
All user-facing authentication text refers to Internet Identity (passwordless) and does not mention creating a CloudCam AI password.

requirements.text: Ensure the app provides a clear, working login flow via the existing /login route, and that unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when attempting to access protected routes (at minimum: /dashboard and /camera).
acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated, navigating to /dashboard redirects to /login.
When not authenticated, navigating to /camera redirects to /login.
After successful Internet Identity login, the user is redirected to /dashboard.

requirements.text: Ensure a basic user account record is created and persisted for each authenticated principal the first time they use the app, using the existing backend profile record (principal, createdAt, tier) and the existing getCallerUserProfile flow.
acceptanceCriteria: After logging in with Internet Identity and visiting the dashboard, a caller profile exists in the backend (auto-created if missing).
Refreshing the dashboard continues to load the same persisted profile data for that principal (createdAt remains stable across reloads).

requirements.text: Update all user-facing product name/branding text in the UI to consistently say “CloudCam AI” (English), including fixing the HTML document title currently using the old name.
acceptanceCriteria: The browser tab title uses “CloudCam AI” (not “CloutChem AI”).
No visible UI strings show the old product name.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if persistent state schema changes.

Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other paths listed as immutable: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Custom username/password authentication is not supported on this platform; authentication must use Internet Identity.
nonGoals: Implementing username/profile-picture profiles, username uniqueness/cooldowns/offensive-word filtering.
Implementing media uploads (images/videos), public/private post visibility, feed, friends, likes, or comments.
Adding subscriber-based gating beyond what already exists.
